referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Gartside Street Dental Lounge website in Manchester, England uses deep navy welcome panel balancing a large portrait or clinic image. Navigation is dark bar with direct consultation and contact routes. Its page moves through dark opening, welcome statement, practice story, treatment index, facilities feature, team profiles, patient review area, visit and consultation close, with distinct treatment groups after the opening narrative. practice rooms and people arranged as editorial panels. Transferable mechanics are navy opening stage, grouped treatment index, facility image chapter. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
